reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Wisconsin
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: When a landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant,
    does the law require they offer tenants assistance with relocation costs?

    Provided statutes to encode:
      - WI Stat  703.08 (2021) (duplicated in prompt as [1] and [2], same text)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% Basic entities
scenario_state(wisconsin).
scenario_year(2021).

landlord(l1).
tenant(t1).
property(p1).

% Occupancy / relationship
occupied_by(p1, t1).
landlord_owns(l1, p1).

% The scenario: landlord wants to sell an occupied property.
landlord_wants_to_sell(l1, p1).

% Make explicit that the scenario is NOT stated to be a condominium conversion.
% (This prevents accidental application of condo-conversion-specific statute logic.)
condominium_conversion_planned(p1, no).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(wisconsin),
    scenario_year(2021),
    landlord(L),
    tenant(T),
    property(P),
    landlord_owns(L, P),
    occupied_by(P, T),
    landlord_wants_to_sell(L, P),
    condominium_conversion_planned(P, no).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations: WI Stat  703.08 (2021)
%% Notice prior to conversion of residential property to condominium.
%%
%% NOTE: The prompt includes  703.08 twice ([1] and [2]) with identical text.
%% We encode it once; it represents the 2021 Wisconsin rule.
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Helper: statute applicability for condo conversions. */
statute_70308_applies(State, Year, Property) :-
    State = wisconsin,
    Year = 2021,
    condominium_conversion_planned(Property, yes).

/* WI Stat  703.08(1) (2021):
   Owner must give prior written notice of the conversion to each tenant. */
statute_70308_duty_prior_written_notice(State, Year, Owner, Property, Tenant) :-
    statute_70308_applies(State, Year, Property),
    landlord_owns(Owner, Property),
    occupied_by(Property, Tenant).

/* For completeness, model the "first right to purchase" window (60 days after notice).
   The statute grants this right only if:
     - notice was delivered, and
     - the unit is offered for sale during the 60-day period after delivery, and
     - the tenant has not waived the right in writing.
*/
% Facts that could be present in a scenario (not present in this question).
% notice_delivered(Property, DayNumber).
% unit_offered_for_sale(Property, DayNumber).
% tenant_waived_in_writing(Tenant, first_right_of_purchase).  % optional fact

statute_70308_first_right_to_purchase(State, Year, Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_70308_applies(State, Year, Property),
    occupied_by(Property, Tenant),
    notice_delivered(Property, NoticeDay),
    unit_offered_for_sale(Property, OfferDay),
    DaysAfter is OfferDay - NoticeDay,
    DaysAfter >= 0,
    DaysAfter =< 60,
    \+ tenant_waived_in_writing(Tenant, first_right_of_purchase).

/* WI Stat  703.08(2) (2021):
   Tenant may not be required to vacate during the 120-day period after notice,
   except for (a) violation of lease covenant or (b) nonpayment of rent.
*/
% Facts that could be present in a scenario (not present in this question).
% landlord_requires_vacate(Property, Tenant, DayNumber).
% lease_covenant_violation(Tenant, Property).
% nonpayment_of_rent(Tenant, Property).
% tenant_waived_in_writing(Tenant, right_to_remain).

statute_70308_prohibits_require_vacate_within_120_days(State, Year, Owner, Tenant, Property) :-
    statute_70308_applies(State, Year, Property),
    landlord_owns(Owner, Property),
    occupied_by(Property, Tenant),
    notice_delivered(Property, NoticeDay),
    landlord_requires_vacate(Property, Tenant, VacateDemandDay),
    DaysAfter is VacateDemandDay - NoticeDay,
    DaysAfter >= 0,
    DaysAfter =< 120,
    \+ tenant_waived_in_writing(Tenant, right_to_remain),
    \+ statute_70308_vacate_exception_applies(Tenant, Property).

statute_70308_vacate_exception_applies(Tenant, Property) :-
    lease_covenant_violation(Tenant, Property).
statute_70308_vacate_exception_applies(Tenant, Property) :-
    nonpayment_of_rent(Tenant, Property).

/* WI Stat  703.08(3) (2021):
   Tenant may waive in writing the first right of purchase and/or right to remain.
   (Represented via tenant_waived_in_writing/2 facts if present.)
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal question mapping: relocation assistance requirement?
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The provided statute ( 703.08) creates notice and certain occupancy/purchase rights
   for condominium conversions; it does NOT impose any duty to offer relocation-cost
   assistance when a landlord sells an occupied property.

   We therefore model "requires relocation assistance" as a predicate that would
   succeed if some encoded statute created that duty. With only  703.08 provided,
   there are no such success conditions.
*/
legal_requires_relocation_assistance(_State, _Year, _Landlord, _Tenant, _Property) :-
    fail.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer derivation (must be derived, not hardcoded)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    landlord(L),
    tenant(T),
    property(P),
    landlord_owns(L, P),
    occupied_by(P, T),
    landlord_wants_to_sell(L, P),
    legal_requires_relocation_assistance(State, Year, L, T, P),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: When a landlord wants to sell a property occupied by a tenant, does the law require they offer tenants assistance with relocation costs?
